newsitem.title: UK: UK shares open lower, depressed by election gloom.
newsitem.headline: UK shares open lower, depressed by election gloom.

text.p: UK shares opened mostly lower on Monday, weighed down by Wall Street's decline on Friday and expectations of clear victory for the opposition Labour victory in Thursday's UK election.
Talk of an interest rate rise next week of as much as a half point also weighed on the market at the opening, with the FTSE 100 index down 4.5 points at 4,365.2 by 0740 GMT.

Decliners were in a three-to-five majority, with B.A.T down after a U.S. court ruling that tobacco could be classified as a drug. Ex-dividends including Guardian Royal also took some two points off the index's value.
